title: Application for Licence for Distribution of Electricity by East African Crude Oil Pipeline (EACOP) Limited
text:
PUBLIC NOTICE
Application for Licence for Distribution of Electricity by
EAST AFRICAN CRUDE OIL PIPELINE (EACOP) LIMITED
In accordance with Section 33 of the Electricity Act, Cap. 157, the Electricity Regulatory
Authority (ERA) has received an Application for a Licence from EAST AFRICAN CRUDE OIL
PIPELINE (EACOP) LIMITED for the Distribution of Electricity along the crude oil pipeline.
The Licence Application by EAST AFRICAN CRUDE OIL PIPELINE (EACOP) LIMITED is in respect
of; construction, ownership and operation of; transformers, associated switchgear in seven
(7) substations, and 273km 33kV underground cable distribution network spanning from;
the Kabaale Electrical Hub substation in Hoima district to Kyotera district. The distribution
network shall run parallel to the crude oil pipeline through eight (8) districts: Hoima, Kakumiro,
Mubende, Gomba, Sembalule, Lwengo, Rakai and Kyotera (the distribution area).
In line with Section 35 of the Act and Regulation 8 of the Electricity (Application for Permit,
Licence and Tariff Review) Regulations, 2007, affected parties and the public are invited
to inspect the Applications, within the limits of commercial confidentiality, at any of the
Authority’s offices below: -
Interested persons are invited to inspect the Application/Notice from the addresses below: -
1. ERA House,
Plot 5C-1, 3rd Street – Lugogo, Industrial Area, Kampala
2. ERA Northern Region Office,
Plot 1, Sir Samuel Doe Road, Gulu City.
3. ERA Eastern Region Office,
Plot 12A, Masaba Road, Mbale City.
4. ERA Western Region Office,
Plot 7, Galt Road, Mbarara City.
The detailed Application can also be accessed on the Authority’s website at www.era.go.ug
Any objections and representations in respect of the Application may be submitted in
writing (by post, hand delivery, email or any other recorded delivery) to ERA at any of the
addresses listed above or via email: secretary@era.go.ug within 30 (thirty) days from the date
of publication of this Notice.
Dated 20tthh February, 2026
CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER
ELECTRICITY REGULATORY AUTHORITY
ERA House, Plot 5C - 1, 3rd Street - Lugogo, Industrial Area | P.O. Box 10332, Kampala - Uganda
